title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this page continues the 'variations on the loop equation' manuscript (the sequel to La Longue Marche), where Grothendieck builds subgroups G^natural_{rho,sigma} of a profinite group of automorphism data. The previous page set up the following. There is a group Z_{rho,sigma}, of centraliser/stabiliser type, sitting in an exact sequence 1 -> L_0^natural -> Z_{rho,sigma} -> gamma_{rho,sigma} -> 1. Here L_0^natural is a procyclic subgroup generated by (powers of) a loop g_0, and the quotient gamma_{rho,sigma} carries a character chi_sigma to Zhat^x. Given a tau-equivariant homomorphism (69) from G^+ to SL(2,Zhat)/{+-1}, which is the genus-one 'homology' representation, one gets (70) Z_{rho,sigma} -> B'_0. B'_0 is the affine group of matrices (mu lambda; 0 1), which is Zhat semidirect Zhat^x. This produces the morphism of extensions (72), mapping onto 1 -> Zhat -> B'_0 -> Zhat^x -> 1, with g_0^n mapping to n.

This page:
(i) The bottom extension is split by the diagonal torus T'_0 = {diag(mu,1)} (73). If (71), the map L_0^natural -> Zhat, were an isomorphism, the inverse image of T'_0 would split the top sequence. The page reads: 'le scindage que donne la 2ème suite exacte en définit par image inverse un dans la première'.
(ii) In the typical cases, however, L_0^natural is deliberately smaller than the full procyclic group. He notes it is perhaps 'not too small to give the right G^natural', yet it is not big enough for (71) to be an isomorphism.
(iii) He therefore adds a hypothesis. Let Z_{rho,sigma}(0) be the inverse image of T'_0 under (70), i.e. the elements whose image has lambda = 0 (74). Since L_0^natural maps injectively to the unipotent radical, Z(0) ∩ L_0^natural = {1} automatically (75). Hence Z(0) -> Gamma_{rho,sigma} is injective. The hypothesis is that it is also surjective, so Z(0) is a section subgroup and Z_{rho,sigma} = Z(0)·L_0^natural (76).
(iv) He states he has good reasons to believe that, once (69) exists, this holds in all truly useful cases.

The next page notes that the choice of Z(0) is functorial and uses it to define (G_{rho,sigma})_0 inside G^natural. He then questions whether a finer definition is needed, observing that in the universal case (G^natural = Pi_0) the central element l_0 acts trivially.

Purpose: to get a canonical, functorial splitting of an extension 'loop group -> stabiliser -> Galois-type quotient'. This is analogous to choosing a tangential base point at the cusp of M_{1,1}, where the Borel of SL_2 acts.
errors: No mathematical error. The parenthetical (75) is automatic because L_0^natural injects into the unipotent radical Zhat; Grothendieck states it as a property, not a hypothesis, which is consistent.

Unstated equivalent form of hypothesis (76): since (mu,lambda)(1,n) = (mu, mu n + lambda), (76) holds iff the lambda-coordinates of Z_{rho,sigma} lie in the image ideal of L_0^natural in Zhat. This makes the hypothesis checkable, but it is not proved on the page; it is only conjectured ('j'ai de bonnes raisons de penser').

ideas.what: Pull back the torus splitting of the affine (Borel) group Zhat ⋊ Zhat^x along a homomorphism induced by the SL(2,Zhat) representation, to split the extension of a stabiliser group by the procyclic loop group L_0
ideas.modern_name: Splitting via the Borel/diagonal torus; tangential base point at the cusp of M_{1,1}; inertia-decomposition splitting
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard; in the anabelian/GT context, related work by Nakamura, Hain–Matsumoto, Ihara on Galois actions on the genus-one Teichmüller group and cusp decomposition groups
ideas.where_published: Not in Esquisse or the published parts of La Longue Marche in this precise form

ideas.what: Conjecture that the inverse image of the 'good' torus section is always a section subgroup (Z = Z(0)·L_0^natural) in all useful cases where the SL2 representation exists
ideas.modern_name: Existence of a compatible splitting / section conjecture-type statement for a cusp decomposition group (weak analogy only)

deep.surprise_reason: Routine group-theoretic bookkeeping (pulling back a semidirect splitting) inside an exploratory construction. The heuristic conjecture (76) is too context-specific and unsubstantiated to constitute a missed result.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'Semi-direct que dans la 2ème suite exacte ne définit pas image inverse non dans la première' should read roughly 'Le scindage que donne la 2ème suite exacte en définit par image inverse un dans la première'.
'Mais dans les cas typiques que nous [considérons], L_0^natural (qui n'est peut-être pas trop petit pour donner "le bon" G^natural_{rho sigma}!) n'est pas assez gros pour donner un iso dans (71)!'
'[-Pour-] on peut aussi faire une hypothèse supplémentaire' should read '[-Mais-] on peut aussi faire une hypothèse supplémentaire — à savoir que l'image inverse par (70) de la "bonne" section'.
'Z_{rho,sigma}(o) -> Gamma_{rho,sigma}': lowercase gamma_{rho,sigma}, as on the previous page.
Last line: '[-quitte, s'il le faut,-] la choix d'un' should read 'Le choix d'un', with the struck-through phrase being 'quitte, s'il le faut, ...'.
